{"metadata":{"description":"🛡️ 给 DeepSeek Harness 插件拍 X 光 — 插件安全体检与健康检查。只读静态扫描:代码执行/凭据/外传/混淆/安装脚本/bundle 清单,0-100 风险分。DSH tool plugin + standalone CLI。","id":"gh:1337355786","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-sentinel-scanner","slug":"Eligahyu/dsh-sentinel-scanner","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","scanner","security","static-analysis","supply-chain-security"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"🛡️ 给 DeepSeek Harness 插件拍 X 光 — 插件安全体检与健康检查。只读静态扫描:代码执行/凭据/外传/混淆/安装脚本/bundle 清单,0-100 风险分。DSH tool p"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"lugin + standalone CLI。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 🛡️ dsh-sentinel"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Read-only security, supply-chain, and health scanner for DeepSeek Harness plugins**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Heuristic rules, AST/taint analysis, package quarantine, dependency intelligence,
SBOM export, SARIF"},{"id":"p4s2","text":", and CI policy enforcement—without executing scanned code."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"`Node.js ^22.18.0 or >=24.11.0 · Static analysis primary; Phase B dynamic analysis is explicit opt-i"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"n and network-denied · MIT`"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"English · 中文 · Rules ·
Architecture · Roadmap"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What is dsh-sentinel?"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**dsh-sentinel** gives DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins an X-ray before you trust or
install them. It "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"is a read-only static security scanner for plugin source trees,
published npm packages, DSH profiles"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ic security scanner for plugin source trees,
published npm packages, DSH profiles, and CI pipelines."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The scanner looks for command execution, dynamic code evaluation, credential
access, data exfiltrati"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"on, obfuscation, unsafe lifecycle scripts, persistence,
native binaries, manifest escape paths, and "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"package drift. It combines 51
heuristic rules with AST-based taint analysis, bounded module and cros"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"s-file
analysis, supply-chain metadata, and explicit scan-coverage reporting."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Every scan produces a structured report with a **0–100 risk score**, a
`safe / review / risky / dang"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"erous` verdict, evidence for each finding, and
actionable remediation guidance. The same engine is a"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ct, evidence for each finding, and
actionable remediation guidance. The same engine is available as:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- a DSH Agent Tool plugin: `sentinel_scan`, `sentinel_scan_profile`, and
`sentinel_audit_package`;
-"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" a standalone CLI: npm package `deepseek-harness-sentinel`, executable
`dsh-sentinel`;
- a GitHub Ac"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"tion with SARIF upload support;
- a JavaScript API for programmatic integrations."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"> **Security disclaimer:** heuristic static analysis is not a proof of safety.
> A finding means “re"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"view this evidence,” not “this plugin is malicious.” A clean
> report means that enabled checks foun"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"d no issue; it does not guarantee safety."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Why this project exists"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"DSH plugins may run with the same filesystem, network, credential, and process
permissions as the us"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"er or agent that loads them. A small install script, hidden
download-and-execute chain, unsafe tool "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"argument, or escaped manifest path can
therefore become a supply-chain incident."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"dsh-sentinel is designed for two audiences:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **Plugin users:** inspect third-party code before installation or activation.
- **Plugin authors a"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"nd maintainers:** detect dangerous behavior, packaging drift,
incomplete scans, and manifest defects"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"etect dangerous behavior, packaging drift,
incomplete scans, and manifest defects before publishing."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Security model and non-negotiable boundaries"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"1. **Scanned code is never executed.** The scanner does not `require`, `import`,
`eval`, or spawn ta"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"rget code.
2. **Pre-install audit does not run `npm install`.** It downloads a tarball,
verifies int"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"egrity, extracts it into quarantine, scans it, and cleans up.
3. **Source code is not uploaded.** Op"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"tional OSV lookup is disabled by default
and sends only package name and version when enabled.
4. **"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"Secrets are always redacted.** Reports retain fingerprints and evidence
without exposing raw secret "},{"id":"p18s6","text":"values.
5. **Skipped work is visible.** Limits, oversized files, ignored paths, parser
boundaries, a"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"nd policy skips are represented in the report.
6. **Automation is not detection.** SARIF, HTML, GitH"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"ub Actions, and SBOM formats
transport or present results; detection capability lives in the engine."},{"id":"p18s9","text":"
7. **Dynamic analysis is explicit opt-in.** Static analysis remains the default;
`--dynamic` adds a"},{"id":"p18s10","text":" separate Phase B layer and never changes the static result.
8. **Phase B has no host-execution fall"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"back.** It can run only inside a local,
scanner-owned, immutable-image Docker or Podman runner. This"},{"id":"p18s12","text":" checkout has no
compiled/deployed approved image, so production resolution currently reports
`unava"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"ilable` rather than executing a package."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Linux prerequisites and Phase B runner boundary"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The supported release gate is a protected, administrator-managed Linux
self-hosted runner labeled `s"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"elf-hosted`, `linux`, and `dsh-sentinel-phase-b`,
with a local Docker or rootless Podman engine and "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"a preloaded scanner-owned image
referenced by a full `sha256` digest. The protected environment is n"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"amed
`dynamic-analysis-protected`. The image must already be present: Phase B uses
`--pull=never` an"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"d performs no image build. Engine selection is the fixed
`docker|podman` allowlist; the accepted ima"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"ge form is
`^a-z0-9@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$`. Remote endpoints and
contexts are not accepted. Before ei"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"ther engine command, the gate enumerates
exported environment names, canonicalizes them to uppercase"},{"id":"p20s8","text":", and rejects any
non-empty casing variant of `DOCKER_HOST`,
`DOCKER_CONTEXT`, `CONTAINER_HOST`, `CO"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"NTAINER_CONNECTION`, `DOCKER_CONFIG`,
`CONTAINERS_CONF`, `CONTAINERS_STORAGE_CONF`, `PODMAN_CONNECTI"},{"id":"p20s10","text":"ONS_CONF`, or
`XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, then unsets those selectors/configuration variables. It uses
only `"},{"id":"p20s11","text":"/usr/bin/docker` or `/usr/bin/podman`, a controlled empty environment and
`/` as the working directo"},{"id":"p20s12","text":"ry, with Docker bound to
`--host=unix:///var/run/docker.sock` or Podman bound to
`--url=unix:///run/"},{"id":"p20s13","text":"user/<uid>/podman/podman.sock`. An unsafe selector fails
closed before image inspection; the inspect"},{"id":"p20s14","text":" command has a fixed 15-second host
timeout with TERM and 5-second kill-after bounds, while the smok"},{"id":"p20s15","text":"e run has a
fixed 90-second host timeout. The engine socket is never mounted into the
container."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Each allowlisted stage uses a fresh, short-lived runner with the following
fixed properties:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The read-only staging mount is the only package input available to the runner;
the original workspac"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ng mount is the only package input available to the runner;
the original workspace is never mounted."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- `--network=none`; Phase B has no public or private egress and does not provide
a gateway or networ"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"k observation path;
- private PID and IPC namespaces, a read-only root filesystem, a read-only
stagi"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ng mount, a non-root UID, dropped capabilities (all Linux capabilities
are dropped), and
`no-new-pri"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"vileges`;
- bounded CPU, memory, PID, temporary-storage, output, and wall-clock budgets;
